topics.topic: EffectApproval instance model: when a requested record is created, how it is tied to a specific attempt/decision point, and how many can exist across retries/resends
questions: How is an approval request uniquely tied to a specific operation attempt when the same node/map can request approval multiple times across retries/resends?
Can multiple simultaneous `requested` approvals exist for the same run node/map element (same effect decision point), and if yes how are they intended to be decided/used?
What exact event creates a requested EffectApproval record, and can more than one requested/approved record exist for the same node/map element across retries or request_digest changes?

quotes: An approved, unused approval whose `request_digest` no longer matches the request about to be sent stays `approved` and unused and is simply no authority for that send; the kernel then sends under an active grant when one applies, otherwise requests a new approval.
Sending again after `not_applied` is a new attempt under a fresh approval, never under a standing approval (K-08).
judgement.divergence: Behavior A: the kernel enforces at most one open approval per run/node/map decision point and reuses it until it is decided/used; Behavior B: the kernel may create multiple simultaneous `requested` approvals for the same run/node/map across rebuilds/retries, with later sends choosing one by implementation policy; the owner notices different approval queues and the agent/owner notice different run progression.
judgement.why: The model requires fresh approvals in some cases but does not define uniqueness or attempt-level binding rules for EffectApproval records.

topics.topic: Whether a newly created StandingGrant retroactively unblocks runs already waiting for owner approval, and how existing approval records transition
questions: If a run is already `awaiting_approval` at a node and the owner grants a standing grant for that node/version, does the run continue under the grant immediately, and what status should the existing approval record take?
When a grant is created for a node, does it immediately unblock existing runs already waiting for owner approval at that node, or only affect future effect sends?

quotes: | grant a standing approval for a node of a flow's active version, or revoke any active grant | owner | the node of that flow version stops asking, or asks again; granting an already granted node returns the active grant | a `destructive` node or a version that is not active cannot be granted; revoking where no grant is active is refused |

`active` → `revoked`. A grant is given only for a node of the flow's active version
and belongs to that exact version: when another version becomes active, the grant
keeps covering the runs pinned to its version and covers no run of another
version.

The owner may revoke any active grant, whether or not
its version is still the active one; runs of that version then ask again.
judgement.divergence: Behavior A: creating a grant immediately unblocks already-waiting `owner_approval` points for that node/version and execution proceeds under the grant; Behavior B: the grant only affects future sends and existing waiting approvals must still be explicitly decided; the owner and agent notice different run status (`awaiting_approval` vs progressing) and different approval workload.
judgement.why: The texts define that grants stop asking but do not explicitly state transition behavior for runs already waiting on owner approval or the fate of already-requested approvals.

topics.topic: Run.status precedence when some nodes are waiting but other nodes can still run
questions: When a run has at least one waiting node but still has other runnable nodes, what single `status` must be stored: `running`, a waiting status, or does status switch only when no node can progress?

topics.topic: What happens to an already-requested approval if the underlying request payload changes before decision
questions: If the built request changes before the owner decides a `requested` approval, should that pending approval remain decidable, be auto-refused, or be auto-obsoleted?

topics.topic: Whether a run pending on outcome_unknown can be canceled before resolving the unknown attempt, and the fate of that unresolved attempt
questions: If a run is `pending` on `outcome_unknown`, may the owner cancel it without first resolving that unknown attempt, and if so does the unknown attempt remain unresolved forever?

topics.topic: Whether agents are ever allowed to read M22 SpooledFile bytes or bytes are strictly owner-only
questions: May an agent ever read spooled file bytes (for non-personal-data files), or are file bytes owner-only regardless of disclosure class?

topics.topic: Which stable FlowActivation identifier must be persisted and referenced by EffectAttempt.authority
questions: What concrete, stable identifier of a FlowActivation must be stored and referenced by EffectAttempt authority?
